verdict.rationale: ZCode is documented as an AI coding workbench with a terminal agent and multi-agent execution. Users hand it goals and tasks, can trigger tasks remotely from WeChat, Feishu or Telegram, and community users describe working with it through prompts. However, the evidence never states that the product as a whole can be operated through natural-language commands, and its documented setup and configuration use CLI flags and environment variables; one user also reports API connection failures on most prompts. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of natural-language command operation beyond coding tasks (e.g., settings, workspace or session control via prompts), detailed docs on chat-channel command handling, independent corroboration of reliable prompt-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
